How many clusters? Explained variance by k

Source: R/clusters.R
cluster_quality.Rd

For each k, the share of total variance explained by the clustering (between deviance / total deviance) and its gain over k - 1. Variables are standardised. k-means uses nstart random starts (more starts give a more stable answer); "ward" uses Ward hierarchical clustering. Also returns the average silhouette width (when the cluster package is available) as a second opinion.

Usage

cluster_quality(
  data,
  vars,
  k = 2:12,
  method = c("kmeans", "ward"),
  nstart = 25,
  seed = 1
)

plot_cluster_quality(cq, choose = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

vars

Columns to cluster on.

k

Values of k to try.

method

"kmeans" or "ward".

nstart

Random starts for k-means.

seed

Random seed.

cq

Output of cluster_quality().

choose

Optional chosen k, highlighted.
